Together, these tools can help patients stay on schedule.
One simple solution is a weekly pill organizer with a labeled slot for each day.
w: The paragraph states the problem first, then gives solutions: "One simple solution" introduces the first, "Another option" adds the second, and "Together" sums up both tools. "These tools" must follow the sentences that name them.

q: A student is writing a paragraph for a health-policy class. Place the sentences in the order that creates the most logical paragraph, starting with the first sentence.
o: As a result of these changes, falls at one hospital dropped by a third in a year.
Even with that drop, falls remain one of the most common injuries in hospitals.
In addition, nurses now check on high-risk patients every hour.
First, many have installed bed alarms that alert staff when a patient stands up.
Hospitals have tried several ways to reduce patient falls.
w: The topic sentence comes first. "First" and "In addition" present two methods, "As a result of these changes" reports their effect, and "Even with that drop" must follow the sentence that reports the drop.

q: A patient education sheet reads: "Your test shows that you have bradycardia. ___, your heart beats more slowly than normal." Which transition best completes the sheet?
o: In other words
As a result
On the other hand
For instance
w: The second sentence restates the medical term in plain words. "In other words" signals clarification.

n.1: A slow heartbeat is what bradycardia means, not a result of having it.
n.2: "On the other hand" signals contrast, but the second sentence agrees with the first.
n.3: The second sentence defines the term rather than giving one example of it.

q: Read the paragraph from a study-skills guide. (1) Many students believe that cramming the night before an exam is effective. (2) Therefore, research shows that spacing study sessions over several days leads to better recall. (3) For example, students who reviewed material on four separate days remembered more a week later. (4) Overall, spaced practice is a better use of study time than cramming. Which sentence uses an illogical transition?
o: Sentence 2
Sentence 4
Sentence 3
Sentence 1
w: Sentence 2 contradicts the belief in sentence 1, so it needs a contrast transition such as "However," not the cause-and-effect "Therefore."

n.1: "Overall" correctly signals a summary of the paragraph's point.
n.2: "For example" correctly introduces a specific study that illustrates sentence 2.
n.3: Sentence 1 has no transition; it introduces the belief the paragraph will challenge.

q: A school nurse is writing a newsletter paragraph about dehydration. Place the sentences in the order that creates the most logical paragraph, starting with the first sentence.
o: When the body loses more fluid than it takes in, blood volume drops.
Dehydration can develop quickly during a summer heat wave.
For this reason, health officials urge people to drink water before they feel thirsty.
Over time, a person may feel dizzy, tired or confused.
As a result, the heart must work harder to supply the organs.
w: The topic sentence comes first, then a chain of causes and effects: fluid loss lowers blood volume, "As a result" the heart works harder, "Over time" symptoms appear, and "For this reason" gives the advice that follows.

q: A pediatric clinic newsletter reads: "Children need regular checkups to track their growth. ___, older adults benefit from yearly visits that screen for age-related conditions." Which transition best completes the passage?
o: Similarly
Consequently
In conclusion
For example
w: Both sentences describe a group that benefits from regular checkups, so the relationship is comparison. "Similarly" signals comparison.

n.1: Older adults' checkups are not caused by children's checkups, so a result transition is illogical.
n.2: The second sentence adds a new comparison rather than summing up the passage.
n.3: Older adults are not an example of children; the sentence makes a parallel point.

q: A research summary reads: "The trial drug lowered blood pressure in most participants. ___, several participants reported dizziness and headaches." Which transitions could correctly fill the blank? Select all that apply.
o: For instance
Therefore
Similarly
However
On the other hand
w: The second sentence presents a drawback that contrasts with the benefit in the first. "However" and "On the other hand" both signal contrast.

n.0: "For instance" introduces an example of the first sentence, but side effects are not an example of lower blood pressure.
n.1: "Therefore" signals a result, but the side effects are not a consequence of the blood pressure falling in this passage.
n.2: "Similarly" signals a matching point, but a drawback does not match a benefit.
